stem: Hepatitis A virus transmission is classically listed as which route?

options.label: A
options.text: Only mosquito midgut replication before bite spread
options.misconception: Vector. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: Only airborne droplet nuclei lingering for many hours
options.misconception: Measles-like. (does not match the cited teaching point).

options.label: C
options.text: Only latent dorsal-root ganglion virus reactivation
options.misconception: VZV zoster. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: D
options.text: Only sexual spread of oncogenic HPV DNA genotypes
options.misconception: HPV. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: E
options.text: Fecal-oral spread through contaminated feces or hands
